sentences.en: She was awarded a teaching assistantship to help pay for her studies.
sentences.zh: 她获得了助教职位来支付她的学习费用。

sentences.en: The university offers several types of assistantships to graduate students.
sentences.zh: 大学为研究生提供多种助教职位。

sentences.en: He worked hard as a research assistantship to fund his masters degree.
sentences.zh: 他努力工作获得研究助教职位来资助他的硕士学位。

senses.zh: 半工半读助学金， 研究生助教奖学金
